title: SG-8.4 Robust, visible contribution history loading
summary: Contribution history shows loading, empty and error-with-retry states; remaining count derives from history
description: Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) calls listMine(roundId) on open and silently swallows failures, so players see nothing while loading and nothing on error. Desired behavior: the history list shows explicit loading, empty and error-with-retry states, and the remaining count is derived from the loaded history. Why: players must understand what the history area is doing and recover from failures.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sheet is open and listMine is pending, when it renders, then a loading message is shown in the history area
Given listMine resolves with an empty list, when it renders, then an empty-state message is shown and Contributions left equals MAX_PER_PLAYER
Given listMine rejects, when it renders, then an error message and a Retry button are shown, and clicking Retry calls listMine again
Given listMine resolves with N sent items, when it renders, then Contributions left equals MAX_PER_PLAYER minus N

out_of_scope: Changes to submit validation or quota rules
preserve: Existing submit flow, validation messages and Radix dialog behavior

technical_constraints: Use the real listMine client; no mock data in product code
Remaining stays derived from entries, not a separate counter
definition_of_done: All three requirements implemented and unit tested
